D/ [--]TAN TINVS PF AVG ; R/ [FEL TEMP REPA]RATIO

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), probably Emperor on galley issue of 348-350, Reece period 18, Trier mint. Drilled right of centre and chipped. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: [--]TAN TINVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Figure, clothed, probably emperor in military dress, holding standard on galley.
